008package paint.ui.dialogs.project;
009
010import paint.shared.utils.PaintPrefs;
011import paint.shared.utils.PaintRuntime;
012
013import javax.swing.*;
014import java.awt.*;
015import java.awt.event.ActionEvent;
016import java.util.function.Consumer;
017
018import static paint.ui.dialogs.ProjectDialog.DialogMode;
019
020/**
021 * Bottom bar panel containing Save Experiments, Verbose toggle, optional Sweep toggle (TRACKMATE),
022 * and OK/Cancel buttons. The controller registers callbacks using onOk(), onCancel(),
023 * onVerboseToggle(), and onSweepToggle(). This panel handles wiring the Swing events into those
024 * callbacks and updating UI state (running, completed, enabled, etc.).
025 */
026public class BottomBarPanel {
027
028    private final             JPanel    panel = new JPanel(new BorderLayout());
029
030    private final             JCheckBox saveExperiments;
031    private final             JCheckBox verbose;
032    private final             JCheckBox sweep; // TRACKMATE only
033    private final             JButton   okBtn;
034    private final             JButton   cancelBtn;
035
036    /** Where the durable UI preferences live — the same store that remembers Verbose. */
037    private static final      String   PREFS_SECTION         = "Runtime";
038    private static final      String   PREF_SAVE_EXPERIMENTS = "Save Experiments";
039
040    // Default no-op callbacks so invocation is always safe
041    private static final      Runnable NO_OP = () -> {};
042    private static final      Consumer<Boolean> NO_OP_BOOL = b -> {};
043
044    private Runnable          onOk      = NO_OP;
045    private Runnable          onCancel  = NO_OP;
046    private Consumer<Boolean> onVerbose = NO_OP_BOOL;
047    private Consumer<Boolean> onSweep   = NO_OP_BOOL;
048
049    /**
050     * Constructs the bottom bar for the given mode.
051     * In TRACKMATE mode, the Sweep checkbox is shown; otherwise omitted.
052     */
053    public BottomBarPanel(DialogMode mode, boolean verboseDefault) {
054        JPanel left  = new JPanel(new FlowLayout(FlowLayout.LEFT));
055        JPanel right = new JPanel(new FlowLayout(FlowLayout.RIGHT));
056
057        verbose         = new JCheckBox("Verbose", verboseDefault);
058        left.add(verbose);
059
060        // Sweep checkbox only exists in TRACKMATE mode
061        if (mode == DialogMode.TRACKMATE_BATCH) {
062            sweep           = new JCheckBox("Sweep", false);
063            left.add(sweep);
064        } else {
065            sweep           = null;
066        }
067
068        // SaveExperiments checkbox not in TRACKMATE_SINGLE mode.
069        //
070        // This is a durable preference, like Verbose: "remember which experiments I picked".
071        // It used to be hardcoded to false on every open, so the user had to re-tick it every
072        // single run — and if they forgot, ProjectDialogController silently skipped writing the
073        // selection and it was lost. Seed it from the stored preference and write the
074        // preference back the moment it is toggled.
075        if (mode != DialogMode.TRACKMATE_SINGLE) {
076            saveExperiments = new JCheckBox(
077                    "Save Experiments",
078                    PaintPrefs.getBoolean(PREFS_SECTION, PREF_SAVE_EXPERIMENTS, false));
079            saveExperiments.setToolTipText(
080                    "Remember the selected experiments and pre-select them next time, "
081                            + "in this and the other Paint tools.");
082            saveExperiments.addActionListener(e ->
083                    PaintPrefs.putBoolean(PREFS_SECTION, PREF_SAVE_EXPERIMENTS,
084                            saveExperiments.isSelected()));
085            left.add(saveExperiments);
086        } else {
087            saveExperiments = null;
088        }
089
090        okBtn     = new JButton("OK");
091        cancelBtn = new JButton("Cancel");
092        right.add(okBtn);
093        right.add(cancelBtn);
094
095        panel.add(left,  BorderLayout.WEST);
096        panel.add(right, BorderLayout.EAST);
097
098        verbose.addActionListener(this::handleVerbose);
099        if (sweep != null) {
100            sweep.addActionListener(this::handleSweep);
101        }
102        okBtn.addActionListener(this::handleOk);
103        cancelBtn.addActionListener(this::handleCancel);
104    }
105
106    /**
107     * Returns the Swing component for embedding.
108     */
109    public JPanel component() {
110        return panel;
111    }
112
113    /**
114     * Registers the callback invoked when OK is pressed.
115     * If null is passed, it resets to a no-op callback.
116     */
117    public void onOk(Runnable r) {
118        this.onOk = (r != null ? r : NO_OP);
119    }
120
121    /**
122     * Registers the callback invoked when Cancel is pressed.
123     * If null is passed, it resets to a no-op callback.
124     */
125    public void onCancel(Runnable r) {
126        this.onCancel = (r != null ? r : NO_OP);
127    }
128
129    /**
130     * Registers a callback for when the Verbose checkbox toggles.
131     * NOTE: Current implementation resets onVerbose to a no-op. This is called once by the controller.
132     */
133    public void onVerboseToggle(Consumer<Boolean> c) {
134        this.onVerbose = (c != null ? c : NO_OP_BOOL);
135    }
136
137    /**
138     * Registers a callback for when the Sweep checkbox toggles.
139     * If null is passed, it resets to a no-op Boolean consumer.
140     */
141    public void onSweepToggle(Consumer<Boolean> c) {
142        this.onSweep = (c != null ? c : NO_OP_BOOL);
143    }
144
145    /**
146     * Enables or disables all interactive widgets.
147     * Note: the controller should generally NOT use this during a run,
148     * so that Cancel can remain enabled.
149     */
150    public void setEnabled(boolean enabled) {
151        panel.setEnabled(enabled);
152
153        if (saveExperiments != null) {
154            saveExperiments.setEnabled(enabled);
155        }
156        verbose.setEnabled(enabled);
157        if (sweep != null) {
158            sweep.setEnabled(enabled);
159        }
160        okBtn.setEnabled(enabled);
161        cancelBtn.setEnabled(enabled);
162    }
163
164    public void updateOkEnabled(boolean enabled) {
165        okBtn.setEnabled(enabled);
166    }
167
168    /**
169     * Displays the transient “Running…” state when a background task starts.
170     */
171    public void showRunning() {
172        okBtn.setText("Running...");
173        okBtn.setEnabled(false);
174        cancelBtn.setEnabled(true);
175    }
176
177    /**
178     * Displays the “Completed” state for a short time, then restores OK.
179     */
180    public void showCompleted(boolean keepEnabled) {
181        okBtn.setText("Completed");
182        okBtn.setEnabled(keepEnabled);
183        new javax.swing.Timer(1500, evt -> okBtn.setText("OK")).start();
184    }
185
186    /**
187     * Restores the OK button label and enabled state.
188     */
189    public void resetOk(boolean enabled) {
190        okBtn.setText("OK");
191        okBtn.setEnabled(enabled);
192        cancelBtn.setEnabled(true);
193    }
194
195    /**
196     * Returns whether the “Sweep” mode checkbox is selected.
197     * Only meaningful when mode is TRACKMATE; otherwise returns false.
198     */
199    public boolean isSweepSelected() {
200        return sweep != null && sweep.isSelected();
201    }
202
203    /**
204     * Sets the Sweep checkbox selection state if it exists.
205     */
206    public void setSweepSelected(boolean selected) {
207        if (sweep != null) {
208            sweep.setSelected(selected);
209        }
210    }
211
212    /**
213     * Event handler for the Verbose checkbox.
214     */
215    @SuppressWarnings("unused")
216    private void handleVerbose(ActionEvent e) {
217        boolean value = verbose.isSelected();
218        PaintRuntime.setVerbose(value);
219        onVerbose.accept(value);
220    }
221
222    /**
223     * Event handler for the optional Sweep checkbox.
224     */
225    @SuppressWarnings("unused")
226    private void handleSweep(ActionEvent e) {
227        onSweep.accept(sweep.isSelected());
228    }
229
230    /**
231     * Event handler for the OK button.
232     */
233    @SuppressWarnings("unused")
234    private void handleOk(ActionEvent e) {
235        onOk.run();
236    }
237
238    /**
239     * Event handler for the Cancel button.
240     */
241    @SuppressWarnings("unused")
242    private void handleCancel(ActionEvent e) {
243        onCancel.run();
244    }
245
246    /**
247     * Show UI state while cancellation is in progress.
248     * Cancel is disabled to avoid double clicks.
249     */
250    public void showStopping() {
251        okBtn.setText("Stopping...");
252        okBtn.setEnabled(false);
253        cancelBtn.setEnabled(false);
254    }
255
256    public void keepCancelEnabled() {
257        cancelBtn.setEnabled(true);
258    }
259
260    public boolean isSaveExperimentsSelected() {
261        return saveExperiments != null && saveExperiments.isSelected();
262    }
263}
